name: Bung - 50mm - Bottom Ring - Vented
description: Engineered specifically for 210L barrels and chemical drums, this 50mm bottom-ring bung plug incorporates an advanced microporous silicone vent membrane. It allows continuous pressure equalization, preventing container bloating or paneling caused by volatile chemical off-gassing while providing an impermeable liquid seal.

name: 50mm - Bottom Ring Bung
description: Standard solid 50mm bung plug featuring a bottom-groove LLDPE sealing ring. Precision injection-moulded with reinforced wrench-drive lugs for seamless torque application without stripping. Ideal for petroleum, paints, lubricants, and standard liquid packaging in 210L barrels.

name: 50mm - Top Ring Bung (Metal Drum)
description: Specifically engineered for 210L metal steel drums fitted with internal liners. The top-ring shoulder seat ensures tight compression against the steel flange opening, eliminating thread leakage during long-distance transit and pallet vibration.

name: 50mm - Top Ring Bung - Type A
description: Type-A variant featuring reinforced drive teeth and modified crest angles for high-speed automated drum filling lines. Provides high torque retention and unyielding seal integrity under extreme hydrostatic pressure.

name: 75mm - Bottom Ring Bung
description: Extra wide 75mm (3-inch) heavy duty bung plug designed for rapid-discharge drums and viscous chemical containers. Engineered with a bottom groove LLDPE gasket for robust leak prevention under bulk shipping conditions.

name: 75mm - Top Ring Bung
description: Heavy duty 75mm top-ring bung plug equipped with a high-durability elastomeric PVC ring. Provides superior solvent and oil barrier resistance while withstanding aggressive clamping forces.

name: Screw Cap - 25mm
description: Compact precision screw cap for 50L to 100L side-mouth drums and carboys. Manufactured from high-density polyethylene for tight closure, uniform torque engagement, and clean thread sealing.

name: Screw Cap - 30mm
description: High-demand 30mm screw cap tailor-made for 5L jerrycans, canisters, and small liquid containers in retail agrochemical, oil, and consumer chemical packaging.

name: Screw Cap - 48mm Type A
description: Heavy duty 48mm Type-A screw cap engineered for 30L - 40L drums and jerrycans. Features reinforced sidewalls and sharp anti-slip knurling for easy manual or mechanical cap application.

name: Screw Cap - 48mm Standard
description: Standard industrial 48mm screw cap offering consistent pitch accuracy and reliable seal engagement on 30L to 40L commercial plastic containers and canisters.

name: Screw Cap - 50mm Heavy Duty
description: Industry-standard 50mm (2-inch) heavy duty screw cap for 30L to 100L drums, carboys, and jerrycans. Built to withstand rough cargo handling and stack pressures while preventing chemical evaporation and seepage.

name: Screw Cap Vented - 48mm
description: 48mm screw cap equipped with an integrated venting mechanism. Releases internal pressure buildup caused by hydrogen peroxide, sodium hypochlorite, and agricultural fertilizers while blocking liquid ingress and egress.

name: Screw Cap Vented - 50mm
description: Premium 50mm vented closure combining a secondary elastomeric PVC sealing ring with an active venting membrane. Recommended for volatile agrochemicals, oxidizers, and temperature-sensitive chemicals stored in 30L - 100L containers.

name: Screw Cap - 150mm (6 Inch Mouth)
description: Wide-mouth 150mm (6-inch) screw cap for 50L drums and specialized industrial carboys. Facilitates rapid pouring, pump tube insertion, and easy cleaning of viscous liquids.

name: Screw Cap - 200mm (8 Inch Mouth)
description: Extra wide 200mm (8-inch) threaded screw cap for 100L heavy drums and large storage carboys. Delivers high impact resistance and dependable containment for bulk paints, pastes, and viscous solutions.

name: Screw Cap - 250mm (10 Inch Mouth)
description: Large 250mm (10-inch) threaded closure designed for 30L to 50L wide-mouth threaded drums and carboys. Provides uncompromised sealing over large surface diameters.

name: Open Top Drum Lid - 250mm
description: Full open top drum lid for 30L to 50L open-head drums (mouth diameter 10 inches). Compatible with circular lever-lock clamping rings for airtight containment of powders, solids, and semi-liquids.

name: Open Top Drum Lid - 350mm
description: Heavy-duty 350mm (14-inch) full open-head lid for 50L to 60L open-top industrial drums. Moulded with heavy stiffening ribs for stacking resistance and perimeter gasket seating.

name: IBC DN150 Top Lid Vented
description: Standard 150mm top filling lid for 1000L Intermediate Bulk Containers (IBCs). Features a central automatic pressure breather valve to equalize atmospheric pressure during thermal expansion and bulk emptying.

name: IBC DN150 Top Lid Standard
description: Solid non-vented top lid for DN150 IBC tanks. Provides maximum airtight security for non-gassing liquids, hazardous chemical transport, and long-term bulk storage.

name: Insert - 25mm
description: Precision-moulded 25mm (1-inch) press-fit neck insert for 50L to 100L side-mouth drums and carboys. Acts as a secondary liquid barrier beneath the screw cap to eliminate leakage during transit.

name: Insert - 48mm
description: Press-fit 48mm neck insert for 30L - 40L drums and jerrycans. Tight interference fit seals neck irregularities and provides drip-free containment.

name: Dust Protector Insert - 50mm (Single Use)
description: Single-use hygienic 50mm dust protector insert. Prevents foreign particles, dust, and moisture from entering clean drums during pre-fill storage and warehouse staging.

name: Insert - 50mm Standard
description: Heavy duty 50mm (2-inch) press-fit insert designed for 30L to 100L chemical drums and heavy carboys. Engineered with an easy-pull tab for effortless removal by end-users.

name: Insert - 150mm (6 Inch Mouth)
description: Wide 150mm (6-inch) neck insert for 50L drums and bulk carboys. Provides firm internal compression against wide cap threads.

name: Insert - 200mm (8 Inch Mouth)
description: Large 200mm (8-inch) neck insert for 100L chemical and pharmaceutical storage carboys. Flanged rim locks firmly into container mouth to prevent liquid splashing.

name: Insert - 250mm (10 Inch Mouth)
description: Heavy-gauge 250mm (10-inch) neck insert for 50L to 100L large opening drums and carboys. Prevents volatile vapor loss and enhances packaging stability.

name: DN80 Integrated Thread Butterfly Valve
description: High-flow DN80 (3-inch) integrated thread butterfly valve for intermediate bulk containers (IBCs). Features a chemical-resistant EPDM sealing ring and precision-engineered disc flap that ensures smooth opening, low operating torque, and zero drip shut-off.

name: DN80 Female Welded Butterfly Valve
description: DN80 female welded butterfly valve for direct ultrasonic or thermal welding onto IBC tank blow-moulded necks. Guarantees permanent, leak-proof bottle-to-valve integration without mechanical thread weakness.

name: DN50 Split Thread Ball Valve
description: DN50 (2-inch) split thread ball valve featuring a precision-polished spherical core and fine-thread collar with an EPDM sealing ring. Offers high chemical tolerance and bidirectional sealing for acid, solvent, and fertilizer discharge.

name: DN50 Split Thread Butterfly Valve
description: Compact DN50 split thread butterfly valve. Light weight and reliable, designed for standard IBC pallet tank bottom dispensing with an EPDM elastomeric sealing ring.

name: DN50 Female Ball Valve
description: DN50 female ball valve reinforced with an external aluminum hoop to prevent flange deformation under mechanical stress. Features premium EPDM sealing rings for aggressive liquid containment.

name: DN50 Welded Butterfly Valve
description: Ultrasonic weld-mount DN50 butterfly valve for IBC container manufacturers. Weighing only 270g, it provides reliable flow control with zero leak risk at the base junction.

name: DN50 Female Welded Butterfly Valve
description: DN50 female welded butterfly valve for high-integrity IBC factory assembly. Smooth manual lever handle with secure detent positions.

name: DN50 Integrated Threaded Ball Valve
description: Robust DN50 ball valve with one-piece integrated molded threads. Eliminates assembly seams, providing maximum resistance to hydraulic shock and external mechanical impact.

name: DN50 Split Integrated Thread Ball Valve
description: DN50 ball valve fitted with a high-strength plastic collar hoop and an EPDM gasket ring. Ideal for corrosive fluids where metal hoop exposure is not permitted.

name: DN50 Camlock Welded Ball Valve
description: DN50 welded ball valve equipped with a quick-connect Camlock outlet adapter. Allows instant hose hookup without wrenching, drastically cutting batch transfer turnaround times.

name: DN50 Camlock Ball Valve
description: Thread-mount DN50 ball valve with male Camlock quick disconnect. Offers full compatibility with industrial hose couplers, cam arms, and dust caps.

name: Bung Dust Cover
description: Protective snap-on bung dust cap for 210L chemical barrels. Shields the bung opening from rain, dirt, mud, and external contaminants during yard storage and open flatbed transit.

name: Industrial Drum Spanner Wrench
description: Multipurpose ergonomic HDPE drum opening spanner wrench. Specially designed jaws securely grip 30mm & 50mm screw caps as well as 2-inch and 3-inch bung plugs for effortless opening and closing without damaging closure threads or creating sparks.

name: Heavy Duty Container Rivet
description: High shear strength plastic rivet for mounting container handles and structural brackets on 50L rocket drums and 50L jerrycans.

name: Container Mounting Lug
description: Moulded container mounting lug designed for handle attachment points on 50L rocket drums and heavy carboys. High load-bearing capacity.

name: High-Strength Handle Set for Drums
description: Heavy duty ergonomic handle set for 30L to 80L industrial plastic drums. High tensile polymer compound tested to withstand up to 120kg vertical dynamic lifting load.

name: Sealing Ring - 250mm (10 Inch)
description: Precision circular sealing gasket ring for 30L full open-top mouth drums (10-inch diameter). Provides tight elastomeric seal under metal and plastic drum closing rings.

name: Drum Locking Clip
description: Tamper-evident drum security locking clip for 30L to 50L clamp-ring drums. Locks the closing latch and breaks on initial opening, giving clear proof of transit integrity.
